label: <DEL> step of length-9 sequences (content-gated)
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (t == L), almost exclusively when L == 9 (365/369 dev activations; the other 4 are at L == 8). Never fires in the original or copy phases. Within L=9 delimiter steps it fires on only ~2%, selected by sequence content in a distributed way: first token q (8x lift, 31% of mass) or y, second token h/y, third token k/2, last token t/w all raise the rate; combining these (>=2 cues) gives only F1 ~0.28, so the content gating is not captured by a simple rule. The strongest activations have orig(0)=q plus several of these cues. Magnitude is tiny (max 0.013 above threshold). The predicate has ~0.99 recall / mass recall but ~0.02 precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=q (+3.34), orig2=k (+3.01), orig2=h (+2.83), next_out=h (+1.90), next_out=k (+1.83), orig2=2 (+1.77). Lower it: in_count=1 (-2.61), in_first=0 (-2.36), orig7=- (-1.91), orig8=- (-1.88).
